note: Family campground on 42 acres beside the Shiawassee River near Durand, among old-growth trees; run by GatherGrounds Resorts (also The Oaks near Jackson and Ridge Ranch in Ohio). Spring-fed swimming lake with a sand beach and a Wibit floating water park, on-site canoe/kayak livery, dog park, themed weekends. Seasonal sites are also sold; the operator does not say how many. The gate camera reads license plates, so every vehicle's plate goes on the reservation. --Claude
summary: Operator page (about 200 sites, 80 full hookup with 50-amp, season May 1 - Oct 20) and its ResNexus engine (2027 midweek: W/E 30-amp $45, 50-amp $51, some 30-amp $55; pull-throughs). Added fees, 50-amp/water/sewer, season, dump/store, booking on ResNexus; count 203 -> 200. The rates/seasonal/amenities pages sit behind a bot check (429, then 'Confirm you are human'); weekend rates and any minimum stay not read. Not a membership or sales resort: nightly sites sold to anyone online. Note cleaned (acreage was 45, operator says 42; hookups, count and booking now in fields).
flags: Long-stay check: the park sells seasonal sites (a 'Seasonal Sites' page and a seasonal-camper payment portal; a testimonial mentions visiting 'friends who are seasonal residents'), and the old note said about half the sites are seasonal; the operator's pages that would say how many were behind a bot check. It passes the tests that could be read: nightly rates on a public booking engine ($45 base, under the US$50 line), no application or membership, and on a June 2027 Wednesday the engine offered 23 RV sites by the night (over 1 in 10 of about 200). No minimum stay was visible on a 1-night midweek quote.

Waterfront re-audit lead: entry is 'pond', but the operator says 'the Shiawassee River runs right alongside the park' with canoe/kayak trips 'launching directly from Walnut Hills', besides the spring-fed swimming lake.
